reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made some exciting changes to the way music plays in Provincia! No more abrupt cuts between day, night, title, and combat music. Our new system features a seamless crossfade that enhances the gaming experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
